description: pkix-revocation/src/ocsp.rs: der_failed() creates a der::Error(Failed, Length::ZERO) and wraps it in Error::OcspParseError. This is used in two places: (1) responseBytes absent in a Successful response, (2) responseType != id-pkix-ocsp-basic. Neither of these is a DER parse failure — they are structural/protocol violations. The caller sees 'OCSP response parse error: failed' for what is actually a malformed-but-DER-valid OCSP response. A dedicated Error::OcspMalformed variant (or OcspResponseFormatUnsupported) would make the error actionable and distinct from a genuine DER decode failure.
title: der_failed() constructs synthetic der::Error for non-parse structural failures in OcspChecker
